title: Introduction to Swift Data Types knowledge check

questions.prompt: What is the most direct learning goal for this lesson?
options: The main goal is to apply static typing in a small Swift example and verify the result.
Use introduction to swift data types only for visual styling.
Skip type checking and accept any result.

questions.answer_key: The main goal is to apply static typing in a small Swift example and verify the result.
questions.explanation: Introduction to Swift Data Types is best learned through a small, verifiable example. Swift checks types at compile time and can often infer a value’s type from its initializer. Add an explicit annotation when it clarifies a boundary or resolves ambiguity.
